Sambhal Police Detained Man for 620 Days Using Preventive Laws

Sambhal police used preventive detention to keep Mulla Afroz in jail for 620 days, even after he was granted bail. This action has highlighted concerns about the application of preventive detention laws. The case involved the National Security Act (NSA).
